instances.text: BIOL_V 155 - Human Biology: Physiology and Introductory Anatomy

children.label: Description
children.value: The principles of biology with particular reference to the human body (anatomy and physiology). (physiology and introductory anatomy). Please consult the Faculty of Science Credit Exclusion Lists: https://vancouver.calendar.ubc.ca/faculties-colleges-and-schools/faculty-science/bachelor-science/credit-exclusion-lists [3-0-0; 3-0-0] Prerequisite: One of CHEM 12, CHEM 100, CHEM 110, CHEM 111 and one of BIOL 11, BIOL 12, BIOL 111.
